en: Psalms 34
By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.

zh: 大衛在亞比米勒面前裝瘋，被他趕出去，就作這詩。

ja: ダビデの詩。彼がアビメレクの前で正気を失ったふりをして、追い出されて去ったとき。

p.src: 1  I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

en: I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
u.src: 1  I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

ja: 34:1 詩篇34篇は折句の詩であり、各節がアルファベットの文字（アレフからタヴの順）で始まる。
en: 34:1 Psalm 34 is an acrostic poem, with each verse starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).

p.src: 2  My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

en: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
u.src: 2  My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

p.src: 3  Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

en: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
u.src: 3  Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

p.src: 4  I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

ja: えられ、 私のすべての
en: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
u.src: 4  I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

p.src: 5  They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

ja: で覆われることはない。
en: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
u.src: 5  They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

p.src: 6  This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

en: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
u.src: 6  This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

p.src: 7  The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

en: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
u.src: 7  The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

p.src: 8  Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

ja: が良い方であることを味わい、見よ。
en: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
u.src: 8  Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

p.src: 9  Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

ja: 徒たちよ。 主を恐れ敬う
たちには乏しいことがないからだ。
en: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
u.src: 9  Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

p.src: 10  The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

ja: えることがある。 しかし、
en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.
u.src: 10  The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

p.src: 11  Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

ja: け。 私はあなたがたに主への恐れを
en: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
u.src: 11  Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

p.src: 12  Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

ja: きたいと願う者は誰か。
en: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
u.src: 12  Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

p.src: 13  Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

ja: りを語らないようにせよ。
en: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
u.src: 13  Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

p.src: 14  Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

en: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
u.src: 14  Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

p.src: 15  The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

en: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
u.src: 15  The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

p.src: 16  The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

en: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
u.src: 16  The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

p.src: 17  The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

ja: かれ、 そのすべての苦難から彼らを助け
en: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
u.src: 17  The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

p.src: 18  The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

en: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
u.src: 18  The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

p.src: 19  Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
u.src: 19  Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

p.src: 20  He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

en: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
u.src: 20  He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

p.src: 21  Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

en: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
u.src: 21  Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

p.src: 22  The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

en: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
u.src: 22  The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
